intro: Ukor's Burden is a heavy bundle of rations hauled out of Razor Hill by a well-meaning orc peon. Intended to feed hungry novices in the Valley of Trials, the unwanted provisions must be hauled back before the wilderness scorpids and raptors pick up the scent.

p: Orc peons rarely act on their own initiative, which makes Ukor's errand unusual. Packing a heavy load of provisions from the inn in Razor Hill, he braved the red dust and aggressive wildlife of Durotar to aid young recruits training in the Valley of Trials. To his dismay, the overseers and instructors turned him away—believing that hardship and lean bellies forge true warriors. Trapped outside the canyon's mouth and terrified of the beasts stalking the trail back, Ukor entrusted the sack to passing travelers to return it to Innkeeper Grosk.
